about: Routing cases (8 Nov 2026, lessons L1/L3 from T3's tool-description hill-climb): cheap cases graded only on the chat's first tool calls (which tool, its arguments, which skill it loads, what it must not call). run.mjs interrupts the run after `stopAfter` calls (default 3), so a case costs a few model calls instead of a full answer. Seeded from logged failures (HILLCLIMB_R15_plus.md, MINED_PATTERNS.md); prompts are new, in the style of the logged ones, on species and records not used by the dev or held-out sets. Ground truth (columns, CAMs) read from the eval app (frozen lab copy of 19 Oct) with direct query calls. Controls are ordinary work: they catch a fix that over-routes (maps-gallery, a draft or a ToolSearch where none belongs). S01–S17 (lesson L2, 8 Nov): one guard per project skill whose listing had no routing case, so a cut to a skill description or to the brief's skills table shows up as a skill no longer loaded; the held-out set files were not opened, so overlap with them was not checked. T01–T05 (8 Nov 2026): one case per tool error class of the weekly retro (2026-11-08, app assistant), each graded so the logged behaviour fails (tests/fixtures/assistant-eval/tool-errors-20261108.json); prompts newly written, on IDs and species no other task uses (4EA, CAM070635), checked in the eval app's frozen copy. T06 (9 Nov 2026): the retro of 2026-11-09's query on a tubes table the eval copy lacks (main's copy has one), on a tube no other task uses (FS3886683).
